units.title: SG-7.6 · Runner locking, timeout, retry, budget and approval gate unit tests
Act: Export ErrTimeout and wrap it in runAttempt
Act: Confirm retry loop and failure cleanup in Runner.run
Act: Confirm lock-first ordering and budget stop in Runner.run
Verify: Timed-out attempt is retried once and fails with ErrTimeout unit tests

tests.name: TestRunTimeoutRetriedOnceThenErrTimeout
tests.title: a timed-out attempt is retried once and the failure wraps ErrTimeout
tests.scenario: Given the agent blocks until its context ends, a 20ms timeout and MaxRetries 1; When Run is called; Then the agent runs twice, the error wraps ErrTimeout and context.DeadlineExceeded, and the stored status is FAILED

tests.name: TestRunParentCancelNotErrTimeout
tests.title: a cancelled parent context is reported as cancellation, not ErrTimeout
tests.scenario: Given the parent context is already cancelled, the agent blocks, a 5s timeout and MaxRetries 0; When Run is called; Then the error is non-nil, wraps context.Canceled, and does not wrap ErrTimeout

units.title: Verify: MaxRetries exhaustion removes the worktree once unit tests

tests.name: TestRunRetryExhaustedRemovesWorktreeOnce
tests.title: Exhausting MaxRetries fails the execution and removes its worktree exactly once
tests.scenario: Given MaxRetries is 2 and the agent fails on all three attempts, When Run is called, Then it returns an error, the agent ran three times, the stored status is FAILED with the last error text, and the worktree under WorkRoot/EXEC-1 is removed exactly once.
tests.detail: PASS in 0.00s; test passed on first run because runner.go already satisfies the spec.

units.title: Verify: Held lock and budget stop unit tests

tests.name: TestRunLockedLeavesNoRecord
tests.title: A run refused by a held World lock leaves no execution record or worktree
tests.scenario: Given the World lock file exists, When Run is called, Then it returns an error wrapping lock.ErrLocked, the agent never runs, no worktree is created and no execution record is stored for EXEC-1

tests.name: TestRunBudgetExceededPersistsFailed
tests.title: A budget stop persists FAILED, wraps ErrBudgetExceeded and removes the worktree once
tests.scenario: Given each agent call costs 3.0, every call fails, MaxRetries is 5 and MaxBudget is 5.0, When Run is called, Then it returns an error wrapping ErrBudgetExceeded after two attempts, the stored record is FAILED with an error containing 'budget exceeded', and the worktree is removed exactly once

units.title: REQ · A timed-out agent attempt returns ErrTimeout and is retried then marked FAILED
REQ · Run stops after MaxRetries failures, marks FAILED and removes the worktree once
REQ · A held lock blocks Run and exceeded budget stops retries with ErrBudgetExceeded
Evidence: Runner locking, timeout, retry and budget unit tests
